class Neuron(object):
    # ...
    def forward(self, inputs):
        # assume inputs and weights and bias
        cell_body_sum = np.sum(inputs * self.weights) + self.bias
        # sigmoid activation function
        firing_rate = 1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-cell_body_sum))
return firing_rate

blocks.content: \begin{array}{l} \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} w ^ {(3)}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} \hat {y}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} a ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} w ^ {(3)}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} \hat {y}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} a ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}} \cdot a ^ {(2)} \\ \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} b ^ {(3)}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} \hat {y}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} a ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} b ^ {(3)}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} \hat {y}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} a ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}} \cdot (1) \\ \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} a ^ {(2)}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} \hat {y}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} a ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} a ^ {(2)}} = \frac {\mathrm{d} J}{\mathrm{d} \hat {y}} \cdot \frac {\mathrm{d} a ^ {(3)}}{\mathrm{d} z ^ {(3)}} \cdot (w ^ {(3)}) ^ {T} \end{array}
